about: Maze2D rollouts of the 'real board vs imagined' viewer at K = 3, 5, 10 and inf, from the full 100-episode Table 1 evals (maze2d ordinary_hard, release 2655748cc8768a33933f886ea87238f2ffacd98d; sha256 = the archive's). tools/figures/make_figure_assets.py --maze2d-archives DIR rebuilds the sprites from them, and with --rank repeats the choice; K = 1 stays the GIF of commit 828b511. 'successes' counts the run's successful episodes, 'usable' those in which every executed action has its own imagined frame (in the others the CoT's chunks do not match the executed ones, or an action has no frame or two). The rule: among the usable episodes whose imagined blue agent dot stays within one maze cell of the real one on average (mean 'dot_offset_px' < 17), the fewest imagined frames without the dot ('dot_missing'), then the smallest mean offset. No successful episode keeps the dot in every imagined frame: Agima drops the agent once it is next to or on the red goal, and at K = 10 every usable success also loses it for steps in the middle of the maze (here steps 7-10, the end of the 10-step chunk). The viewer's caption says so on those frames, and a paused viewer shows a frame with the agent.
